about: The nine ways the object can be got wrong: six this library got wrong at least once, and three a join gets wrong when it travels, narrows, or lands with nobody standing for it. A cell with no ceiling is not a cell; a meet that assumes the reals is a meet of one lattice pretending to be the meet; a state written as a word in the code is a state the lattice did not give. A signature that edits an origin's claim has forged a reading; one that leaves a resting cell where it was has not travelled; and a withdrawal matched by value takes back a claim nobody made.
